places.ai_summary: An iconic symbol of New Orleans, this historic cathedral is known for its stunning architecture and beautiful stained glass.

places.ai_summary: A picturesque neighborhood in New Orleans, famous for its well-preserved antebellum mansions and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot or by bike. Some private homes may have restricted access.

places.name: Mardi Gras World
places.ai_summary: A fun and festive place to learn about the history of Mardi Gras and see stunning parade floats.

places.name: Oak Alley Plantation
places.ai_summary: A historic plantation known for its stunning oak trees and antebellum mansion.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available and recommended.

places.place_tip: Explore the grounds and take a guided tour of the mansion for a glimpse into plantation life.

opening_hours.notes: Bars and music venues may have specific hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the art galleries and catch a live music show at one of the many clubs.

attribution.title: BSicon
attribution.author: Antonsusi
attribution.description: This is the "empty element" of the Icons for railway descriptions (see there for further informations). The original syntax of Wikipedia:Route diagram templates filled all empty spaces in a diagram with this file (all BSicons were 20x20px). For those cells where an icon ID was provided, some "File:BSicon_ID.svg" were used, and where there was no ID, "File:BSicon_.svg" was substituted. Many major Wikipedias has since upgraded the syntax so that just an empty table cell is used (incl. En.WP).
